# Vendored libraries

`hls-1.7.3.light.min.js` is the light UMD build of hls.js 1.7.3. It provides HLS playback for Bluesky videos in browsers without native HLS support. The site loads it only when a visitor starts a video.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hls.js@1.7.3/dist/hls.light.min.js

Project: https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js/tree/v1.7.3

Licence: Apache-2.0, with the distribution's `LICENSE` in `hls-LICENSE`.
